extracted.name: Oat Cookies
extracted.description: These cookies are soft, chewy, and buttery brown sugar cookies made with butter for a rich, slightly caramel-like flavor., They’re filled with rolled oats, which give them a hearty texture and a cozy, homemade feel. A touch of cinnamon adds warmth, and cornstarch keeps them extra soft in the center while the edges bake up lightly golden and crisp. They taste like a mix between a classic cookie and a comforting oatmeal cookie—simple, warm, and really satisfying.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup (100 g) brown sugar (light or dark)
1/2 cup (113 g) butter, cooled (salted or unsalted)
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mix the brown sugar and granulated sugar into the browned butter until smooth.
Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cornstarch, and cinnamon (if using).
Add the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix until just combined (don’t overmix).
Stir in the rolled oats until evenly spread through the dough.
Chill the dough in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Scoop dough onto a baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F (177°C) for 7–8 minutes, until edges look set but centers still look soft.
Let cool on the tray for a few minutes before eating so they firm up.
